doc: The battle's generated headers (src/data/), same schema as manifest.json: 'cmd' run from the repository root with the ROM at Chrono_Trigger_USA_SNES.sfc, 'recipes' built first (tools/recipes/), 'status' rom | power-on | capture ('needs' the private files, 'needs_doc' what differs from today's recipes and why). Order matters: battle_hud_chrome.h is made from battle_hud.h and battle_hud_sub.h. The GATO fight's recipe is battle_gato_press_action (the reference's party positions, the overworld's sparkle in OBJ tiles 0x05/0x15 and the battle's boot phase); its HOLD fight, its 400-frame point (gato_mid), GATO's kill at 6 HP and GATO at 19 HP (battle_end.h) are made by the generators themselves. An entry made from a capture before has a 'proof_doc': what its recipe-made file changed against the capture-made one, and why each change is a byte nothing reads or the rule's cartridge's own value on the recipe state.

generators.proof_doc: Made from the recipe since 2026-10-11. Against the old bake from the capture gato_press_action.state only ctBattleStanceObjPal changed: rows pal2/pal3/pal4 colours 1-12 and pal7 colours 0 and 2-12, OBJ palettes the battle never loads, left over from the field -- the fair's NPC palettes E4#8B/#10/#A1 sit in slots 2/3/4 in the capture and 3/4/2 on the recipe (the order the NPCs claimed them while the party walked the plaza, C0/7170), and slot 7 held the capture's leftover E4 palette #5 where the recipe's CGRAM is zero. They are the cartridge's own CGRAM on the recipe state, and nothing reads them: ctBattleStanceObjPal has no reader in src/. Every combatant byte (the assemblies, tiles 0x00-0x9F, palettes 1/5/6) is the capture's.

Made from the recipe since 2026-10-11. Against the old bake from gato_press_action.state every keyframe, tile sheet and trajectory is the same; ctBattleAnimPal rows pal2/pal3/pal4 colours 1-12 and pal7 colours 0 and 2-12 changed (the field leftovers of battle_stance.h, the cartridge's CGRAM on the recipe state). The engine reads rows 1/5/6 (GATO, Crono, Marle) and, for the status icons (field.c battleStatusIconRender), rows 2/3 -- the palettes of the CC/F6D4 records -- whose tiles (D1/3900) use colours 0/13/14/15 only, the same on both; rows 4 and 7 have no reader.

Made from the recipe since 2026-10-11. The UP rear-up is baked at f185, the middle of the recipe's dwell f175-f194 (the capture's f195 is already the next frame of GATO's stream on the recipe: the capture's lag frames had put its dwell later). GATO's tiles 0x68-0x9F of every pose and every cell are then the capture's, so field.c's animengcheck-atk (the gather of the ROM's assembly 0x11 against ctGatoAtkTiles0 over 0x68-0x9F) stays 56/56. What changed is Crono's tiles, the frame of his own stream where the poke puts him: 0x0A/0x0B/0x0E/0x1A/0x1B in the UP sheet and 0x08/0x0B/0x0C/0x0F/0x18/0x1A/0x1B/0x1C/0x1E/0x1F in both LEFT sheets. Nothing reads them: ctGatoAtkTiles0 is read over 0x68-0x9F only, and ctGatoAtkTiles1-4, ctGatoAtkCell and ctGatoAtkFace have no reader in src/.

Made from the recipe since 2026-10-11. GATO at low HP is a stand-in the generator makes as battle_settle.py makes gato_kill: gato_mid (the recipe's fight 400 frames in) with GATO's $6130 = 19 and Crono's $5E30 = 56 poked as it loads (the HP of the old capture gato_lowhp.state). The mash kills GATO at f601 (the capture's f950) and the victory frame is taken at the capture's distance, kill + 210; Crono's fall is GATO's first action killing him at 1 HP (f235) + 100 frames. Against the old bake: the victory and fallen poses' tiles are the same (keyframes 0, 1, 3 byte for byte, keyframe 2's Crono tiles too); Crono's victory assembly sits (+2,-3) and his fallen one (0,+3) from the capture's (where each fight left him), keyframe 2's sheet carries Marle's frame of the moment (tiles 0x20-0x37), and ctBattleEndPal the recipe's field leftovers (rows 2/3 colours 1-12, row 4 colours 1-3, row 7) and GATO's colour 14 at that frame. Nothing reads battle_end.h: field.c includes it and no source references ctBattleEnd* or CT_END_*.

Made from the recipe battle_forest_3hetake since 2026-10-11 (Crono springs the ambush where the old capture's Crono stood; the battle's counters $0027/$00A4/$00A5 are the capture's). Against the old bake one value changed, ctHetakeObjPal[14], the Hetakes' palette glow: 0x6739 -> 0x4A52, the cartridge's on the recipe state under the rule too (the bake frame peeked with CT_ORACLE_LOGICAL=1 reads 0x4A52); the capture's real-time boot had put the glow 7 frames off in phase. ctHetakeObjPal has no reader in src/ (field.c reads ctHetakeIdle's anchors only). The header's third comment line names the recipe.

Made from the recipe since 2026-10-11 (the capture song_f470 is lost). The bake frame is the recipe's HOLD fight's first song (f1146-1455) + 97, the corpus' song_f470 offset in its span f373-685. GATO sings at (135,85) there, not (128,85); the cells are stored relative to the foot and are the old bake's, and GATO's tiles 0x38-0x9F are the old bake's byte for byte (bodymd5 8ee58439). Crono's and Marle's tiles (29 rows of 0x08-0x37) are their own frames on the recipe, and the comment lines are the generator's (the tree carried an older, hand-edited text). Nothing reads battle_gato_song.h: field.c includes it and no source references ctGatoSong* or CT_GATO_SONG_*.
